title: The Awful smell in the cellar
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：awful　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 awful 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the operator wrote of ① an awful smell in the cellar in the log, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② more awful than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the operator, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the awful ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most awful smell in the cellar anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the log for June 1981 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too awful to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainee who had come to help; the awful ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an awful silence after the news, and said that no trainee in his right mind would call it ⑥ as awful as the silence after the news they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was awful or not, and he said so.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something awful, and nothing besides. The trainee from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite awful; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the awful ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997, before dawn, she wrote of another awful smell in the cellar in the same log, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ more awful than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most awful silence after the news in the whole station, she said in 1999, was the one she could never quite name; the awful ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 糟糕（前置定语 an awful smell in the cellar：1987 年操作员在运行日志里记下的那件糟糕的气味）
B. adj. 糟糕／可怕（比较级 more awful than：文中两处，一处比地窖里的气味，一处比预想）
C. adj. 糟糕／可怕（最高级 the most awful：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 糟糕（表语 too awful to do：母亲觉得它太糟糕，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 可怕（前置定语 an awful silence after the news：叔叔把整件事称作一桩可怕的沉默）
F. adj. 可怕（同级比较 as awful as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩消息后的沉默相比）
G. adj. 可怕（后置定语 something awful：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 可怕（受程度副词修饰 quite awful：那位实习生的评价）

items.q: an awful smell in the cellar
the most awful smell in the cellar anybody
an awful silence after the news
The most awful silence after the news in

answers.why: awful 意为“糟糕”，1987 年操作员在运行日志里记下的是“一件糟糕的气味”，此处作前置定语 an awful smell in the cellar。
awful 意为“糟糕”，此处用比较级 more awful than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
awful 意为“糟糕”，运行日志上 六月 那行字说它是机房里最糟糕的一件，故用最高级 the most awful smell in the cellar。
awful 意为“糟糕”，母亲认为这件东西“太糟糕了，谁也用不上”，too awful to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
awful 意为“可怕”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩可怕的沉默”，此处作前置定语 an awful silence after the news。
awful 意为“可怕”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩消息后的沉默一样可怕”，同级比较用 as awful as。
awful 意为“可怕”，运行日志上那半行字要的是“可怕的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something awful。
awful 意为“可怕”，邻机房来的那位实习生认为这套计划“相当可怕”，quite 修饰原级 awful。
awful 意为“可怕”，1997 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要可怕”，故用比较级 more awful than。
awful 意为“可怕”，母亲 1999 年说的是“整个机房里最可怕的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most awful silence after the news。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1987 年，操作员在运行日志里记下了一件糟糕的气味。（an awful smell in the cellar）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更糟糕。（more awful than …）
母亲觉得它太糟糕，谁也用不上。（too awful to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩可怕的沉默。（an awful silence after the news）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩消息后的沉默一样可怕。（as awful as …）
到了 1994 年，运行日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件可怕的东西。（something awful）
answers: In 1987 the operator wrote of an awful smell in the cellar in the log.
Everybody said it was more awful than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too awful to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an awful silence after the news.
He said nobody would call it as awful as the silence after the news they had once had.
By 1994 the log asked for nothing but something awful.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 awful 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the operator wrote of an awful smell in the cellar in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most awful smell in the cellar in the station, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too awful to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an awful silence after the news, and nobody argued with him.
The trainee from the next station called the plan quite awful, and everybody laughed.
The awful ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
